title: Bound natural-semiring scalar growth
finding: The natural-number reference semiring bounded operation count but not scalar magnitude. Repeated path-count composition could therefore create arbitrarily large Python integers inside an otherwise bounded reference kernel.
primary_claim: Natural-semiring operands and arithmetic results are fail-closed above a 4096-bit diagnostic envelope, preventing unbounded bigint growth without adding a new numeric abstraction or backend.
gardener_decision: Harden the existing reference semiring in place. Do not add bigint wrappers, alternate scalar contracts, or a second arithmetic layer.
acceptance: normal path-count semiring laws remain unchanged inside the bounded envelope
the largest 4096-bit non-negative value is accepted
addition and multiplication refuse when the result crosses the 4096-bit envelope
no OwnerApproval, promotion, gate transition, or benchmark superiority claim is created

verification.claim: Only exact-head executed workflow steps count as evidence.

rollback: Revert the G1-TENSOR-01AK commit; canonical Forest/Fourfold artifacts and identities are unchanged.
